text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I won... I... beat Teio?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Haha... Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, seriously...!? I'm really...—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I lost!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Teio...! I—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Looks like we got our spark!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can get even stronger! Heheh, I'm 
getting so excited!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How many kilometers left until I'm the 
strongest? I'll blast through it in a 
single leap!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, close one. I almost took you 
seriously and got my hopes up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. My win was... just a 
fluke.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Because no matter how you look at it—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"She's the one... who shines so 
brightly..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, right after I won, I was happy, of 
course. I was happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A victory like this has got to be a fluke. 
It wasn't my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because it just doesn't make sense. 
There's no way I'm stronger than Teio."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'm talking about me, the one without a 
single sparkle, you know? Something 
must've gone totally twisted somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's no way this is my true strength. 
If we fight again... I'll definitely lose.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, man! I completely got the wrong 
idea, how embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature had undoubtedly won. Nothing 
could have accounted for that outcome 
other than her own true strength. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, this is so embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, the reason you're as down as 
if you lost is that you lack confidence in 
your own abilities. In other words, you 
have no self-belief. Then what you need 
is—"
choice_data_list: Nature, wanna go on an expedition?
Nature, wanna go on an expedition?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "An expedition...? Wait, why...?"
choice_data_list:
Let's keep getting results through the 
summer

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting her in the Classic campaign right 
now is a dangerous gamble. It might 
shatter even the little confidence she 
currently has.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, taking on local races 
and steadily racking up results will 
surely benefit her growth in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In other words... you're not aiming for 
either the Satsuki Sho or the Japanese 
Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Because I'm not good enough.
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush for now, and focus on 
feeling ourselves get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right. The way I am right now, even 
if I won next time... I wouldn't be 
satisfied.
choice_data_list:
If you push through this summer, you'll 
become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I sure hope so.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mm, okay, okay! Touring around from place 
to place actually kinda suits me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So? You're not seriously going to make me 
tour the rural boondocks, are you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Which race are you aiming for in the end?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A graded race held in Kokura. It's the 
perfect race to help build Nice Nature's 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, the distance is the same as the 
Wakagoma, right? Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Kokura in summer, huh... I'm gonna 
melt..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that we'd aim for 
the Kokura Kinen next!
